notes_for_editor: Unresolved conflicts: pole tower height is 30 feet on firelookout.com (1931 entry) and 30' also in the Idaho Fire Lookouts page's 1931 entry, versus 20 feet on the Forest Lookouts page citing Kresek. The record's height_m 6.1 equals 20 feet; 30 feet would be about 9.1 m. Not proposed as a correction, because height is not one of the correction fields. The 1934 tower's distance is 1/4 mile on two sources and 1/2 mile on Idaho Fire Lookouts. The crow's nest year is 1929 on firelookout.com and c.1929 on the Forest Lookouts page. The record point (47.85057, -116.60907) is about 50 m from the idaho_fl point, so no location correction. No staffing history is documented by any source read. The Idaho Fire Lookouts timeline (cited in the story) also gives the 1931 pole L-4 tower as 30 feet and the destruction as 1955, so all three cited pages agree on the 1955 date; the 1931 height is 30 feet on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts against 20 feet on the Forest Lookouts page citing Kresek. The Faset Peak and 2023 fire-map results are not this site.
